svg.title: PodVigil job lifecycle
svg.desc: Validate each attempt before spending. Optional additional capacity rounds require a definite no-capacity answer and proof that no Pod was created and no volume remains. Between rounds, poll the catalog without creating storage or uploading inputs. Each real attempt keeps a separate ledger. Arm the watchdog, create owned storage and upload inputs, then create one Secure Cloud Pod and verify its identity. Its runtime starts at its own Pod request. Finalize and stop compute before retrieving results. Delete storage only after verified complete backup; otherwise retain it and report billing uncertainty.
svg.text: Placement rounds, one job, verified cleanup
